scientific_question: At the same finite-size distance from the bulk-response crossover, does local H1 identify disorder realizations with anomalously soft spectra?

relationship_to_v1.separation: This is a new physical-only design. The failed signed far-correlation gate is retained and is not reinterpreted. No seed 1300-1349 spectrum or H1 label existed when this v2 reference was frozen.

physical_reference.definition: interior maximum of -d mean(bulk_ms2)/dGamma0, with the frozen three-point local quadratic refinement
physical_reference.interpretation: finite-size bulk-response crossover, not an exact signed boundary and not a thermodynamic critical point
physical_reference.guardrail: The broad intervals are reported as uncertainty in the finite-size crossover. The three delta values probe a local neighborhood and are not asserted to lie definitively in separate thermodynamic phases.

co_primary_endpoints: geometric gap ratio H1-positive versus H1-negative after removing each (L,delta_Gamma0) stratum mean from log(gap01)
stratified AUC of continuous H1 maximum lifetime for predicting the bottom quartile of gap01 within each (L,delta_Gamma0) stratum

inference.low_gap_label: gap01 at or below the empirical 25th percentile inside each of the 12 frozen (L,delta_Gamma0) strata
inference.resampling_unit: the complete three-delta trajectory of one seed within one L
inference.permutation_rule: permute complete H1 trajectories among the 50 seeds separately within each L, preserving dependence across delta_Gamma0
inference.cluster_bootstrap_rule: resample the 50 seed trajectories with replacement separately within each L and retain all three delta observations
inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two co-primary one-sided tests at family-wise alpha=0.05
secondary_tests: H1-by-L interaction with stratum fixed effects and seed-trajectory cluster bootstrap
H1-by-delta estimates reported for all three frozen offsets without subset selection
adjustment for bulk_ms2, selected-window mean J, selected-window mean Gamma and cyclic window position

decision_rule.strong_positive: Both Holm-adjusted co-primary tests pass in the predicted direction and the H1 effect remains after preregistered controls.
decision_rule.limited_positive: At least one co-primary endpoint is positive or the effect is confined to sizes/offsets, but the full strong-positive rule is not met.
decision_rule.negative: Neither co-primary endpoint passes; report that local H1 does not generalize as an out-of-sample soft-gap marker after physical matching.
decision_rule.opposite: The association is significantly reversed; abandon the soft-excitation interpretation and report the direction without retuning the H1 threshold.
